name: AEM electrolysis
principle: An anion exchange membrane carries hydroxide ions between electrodes in a dilute alkaline or pure-water environment. It aims to combine the cheap, platinum-free materials of alkaline electrolysis with the compact, pressurised design of PEM. DOE gives 50 to 80 °C operation.
